original_paper.author: Yves Lepage
original_paper.access_boundary: Publisher metadata and abstract were read. The Oxford PDF was access-blocked, so no complete original-paper body read, hidden derivation, table value, or paper-file hash is claimed.

author_preprint.title: Enhanced Lepage-type test statistics for location-scale shifts with right-skewed data
verified_claims: the classical Lepage statistic combines standardized Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney location and Ansari-Bradley scale components
the Wilcoxon normalized U component and its strong-null variance are stated explicitly
the even-N symmetric end-rank path and Ansari-Bradley expectation and variance are stated explicitly
the classical joint statistic is the sum of the two squared standardized components
under the strong null the classical statistic has an asymptotic chi-square distribution with two degrees of freedom
small-sample exact inference would instead use permutation critical values
adverse_findings: the paper studies biomedical samples rather than WTI
it recommends robustified variants for right-skewed weak-null inference
the EA deliberately uses only the classical L0 arithmetic as a transparent state gate and makes no significance claim
daily return overlap violates the independent-sample interpretation, so the statistic is only a deterministic regime score in this card

verified_claims: the implementation pools x then y and ranks all observations
the location component uses the y-sample rank sum and the classical strong-null variance
the scale component assigns mirrored ranks from both tails and sums the y-sample scores
the even-N scale expectation is n*(N+2)/4
the even-N scale standard deviation squares to m*n*(N+2)*(N-2)/(48*(N-1))
L0 is the sum of the two squared standardized classical components
the reference p-value uses chi-square with two degrees of freedom

carrier_record.role: broad own-return continuation family and explicit NYMEX WTI membership only

claim_boundary: The records support the named joint location-scale rank statistic, exact classical arithmetic, broad own-return continuation family, and WTI carrier membership only. They do not test fixed 25-by-25 daily-return blocks, the chi-square-two median activity gate, one-month continuation, CFDs, fixed risk, activity, profitability, or decorrelation. The EA imports no R, package code, executable source, optimizer, random output, or trained output.
